text.p: German engineering and technology group Mannesmann AG said on Thursday profits in its telecommunications businesses more than doubled in 1996, but were curbed slightly by start-up losses for new activities.
In 1995, the telecommunication division profits totalled 464 million marks ($274.1 million). The company gave no figure for 1996.
The main driver of growth in the telecoms business was the digital cellular phone unit Mannesmann Mobilfunk GmbH, in which Mannesmann holds over 60 percent and Airtouch Communications holds the rest.
The company said after releasing detailed group results for 1996 that turnover in telecoms rose 55 percent to 4.2 billion marks, accounting for 12 percent of group turnover.
-- William Boston, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150 ($ = 1.693 German Marks)
